page_topic_one_liner: Developer documentation tools — docs sites, auto-sync from code, and agent-ready API references
differentiator_vs_generic: Docs site with sidebar nav and live sync arrow from Git repo commits, NOT generic note-taking app or customer support KB widget.
visual_anchors: HERO (~50% canvas): Documentation site frame — left sidebar nav tree (API, SDK, Guides blurred), main content with code sample block and version badge, sync pulse arrow from Git commit icon
Auto-update ribbon: code change → docs PR → publish icons linked by torn-paper arrows (blurred labels only)
2x2 grid of docs output tiles (API reference page, changelog, interactive playground, search results) — UI fragments only
Magnifying glass zooming on code sample block and parameter table row
anti_patterns: Generic notebook or Notion page hero
Empty docs sidebar with blank content
